I want to redo Sky-Scraper, I figured out how to do more than 29 damage. :)

 

Starting in small form with Proportionist in play, and all of her Links in play (important ones being 2 Compulsion Cannisters, and 2 Aggression Modulators) all 3 Undetectable Relinkings in hand, all 3 Colossal Right Hooks, and both Catch a Rides.

1 environment target with 13+hp in play [except Immutus ;) ]

 

Plays: Colossal Right Hook, and first deals 1 Melee damage from Proportionist, then 3 from the hook >4

2 more Colossal Right Hooks >10

Undetectable relinking to bring back 2x Agression Modulators, 2x Compulsion Cannisters, and 1 more link, to play the Aggression Modulators on the environment target, then both Compulsion Cannisters on that same target for 4 damage to itself, and 8 damage to the villain >18

then another Undetectable Relinking to do this same combo, for another 8 damage to the villain >26

last Undectable Relinking is almost the same, except you bring back 3 extra unnamed links >34 (environment target has lost 12hp from hitting itself)

and the extra links let you play both Catch a Rides for 4 from you >38

and 4 from someone else >38(4)

Power: Since she's stuck in small form, her power won't let her do any more damage, as her compulsion cannisters are already in play

So, a total of 42 damage dealt to the villain, (possibly 44 depending if Champion Bot counts*)

 

And for Extremist Sky-Scraper, even though I know she can do so much more by switching forms several times with Proportionist in play, you sadly wouldn't be able to add much more damage from Proportionist, since she still only has one power use, and her small form's power use has the most potential damage. But here's Extremist, all laid out:

Starting in small form with Proportionist in play, and all of her Links in play (All that can be on the target she wants to hit) all 3 Undetectable Relinkings in hand, all 3 Colossal Right Hooks, and both Catch a Rides.

1 environment target with 13+hp in play

 

Plays: (Exactly what I did above on the play phase) >38(4)

Power: At this point, she can only have 6 links on her target. Aggression Modulators can't be on the Villain, nor can Micro-Assemblers, and both Compulsion Cannisters are on the Environment Target. It wouldn't be worth to have put them on the villain with the 3rd Undetectable Relinking, as you'd be adding 2 damage from the power use, but losing 4 damage from the environment dealing amplified damage.

So, on the Villain she has: 2x Cortex Hyperstimulators, 2x Neutralizing Resonators, and 2x Rebounding Debilitators, uses Intravenous Assault for 7 damage >45(4)

then goes to normal size triggering Proportionist >46(4)

So a total of 50 damage (or 52 if the hero target she chose for Catch a Ride was Champion Bot*) dealt to the villain.

 

*Regarding Champion Bot, is that the only self buffing hero target? I can't think of any others. I'm not counting Naturalist's Croc form, or any other hero with a +1 to damage in play, because those are additional cards modifying a target, and that goes against the rules of the thread. Champion Bot specifically says on itself "increase damage dealt by Unity and by mechanical golems by 1"

PF2 activate Pipes --> P of SFFs --> 6 damage x 2 (12) (18 total)

AS then blows up.

Well, after people on the discord server were talking about how much damage VG Dr Medico's variant can do, I decided to do the math. They were right, his potential is huge. Mostly because he can heal several targets at once, and that combos with his variant power to basically turn all that healing into focused damage on one target.

Variant Power: Red Right Hand: Until the end of your next turn, whenever a hero target would regain hp, Dr. Medico deals 1 target that amount of energy damage instead.

His weakness is card play, he can basically only really play one card a turn, no good cards to combo card plays into each other. (One card does, but it just prevents damage to a target. it doesn't heal, do damage, or give powers)

And the important ongoing cards for the combo: 3x Prescription Strength - at the beginning of a hero turn, choose to destroy it to heal that hero for 3hp, then increase all their damage that turn by 1

x2 From the Brink - when a hero would die, prevents the damage, then lets all hero targets regain 2hp. (I'll be making hero targets = 5, for simplicity)

Regeneration(limited): at the end of each hero turn, he heals for 2hp, at the beginning of his turn, he destroys it, and can use a power.

Healing Pulse(limited): At the end of his turn, up to 3 targets can heal for 1 hp each, with a power printed on it: Dr Medico deals himself 2 energy damage, each hero character card other than himself can heal for 2hp

Universal Donor(limited): Whenever Dr Medico is dealt damage, a hero target other than Dr Medico regains 1hp, power on it: One target regains 2hp.

Second Opinion (limited): At the start of his turn, he can destroy this card to deal something 3 damage.

The only important one-shot here is Lifeforce of Will: deals himself 2 damage to heal each other character card for 2hp.

Setup: So previous turn, he played a regeneration, and used his base power, turning his regeneration into 2 energy damage x 5 for each hero turn prior to this one. (10) He's at 5hp. At  the beginning of his turn he had in play: 3x Prescription Strength, 2x From the Brink, Healing Pulse, Second Opinion, Universal Donor, and a Lifeforce of Will in hand.

Beginning of his turn, he destroys each Prescription Strength, and uses them on himself.  for 3 + 4 + 5 damage, and now has a +3 to each instance of damage (22)

Regeneration expires and lets him use a power, which is the one on Healing Pulse. - it first deals himself 5 damage, which would kill him, except for From the Brink, which now triggers and prevents that damage, and tries to heal each Hero target (I'm saying 5 of them for simplicity) for 2hp each. 5 instances of 2[+3] damage each = 25 (47) damage, then removes itself from the game.

Then the rest of Healing Pulse finishes and heals 4 other hero targets try to heal for 2, but instead Dr. Medico deals 4 instances of 2[+3] = 20 (67) damage. He can now destroy Second Opinion, for 6 damage (73)

For his card play, he plays Lifeforce of Will, which triggers From the Brink again, for another 25 (98) and then the last part of Lifeforce goes off, tries to heal 4 heroes for 2, dealing 4x 2[+3] for 20 (118).

For his power phase, he uses the one on Universal Donor, which turns into 5 (125).

At the end of his turn, Healing Pulse triggers, tries to heal 3 heroes for 1, instead deals 3 x  1[+3] for 12 (137)

If you played with 20 something constructs in play, and like 10 or so unity bots in play, and the sentinels, which have 4 hero character cards, you'd probably triple this amount, but I decided not to add that up, for simplicity. You also don't need to count the regeneration damage from the previous round, which is only 10, But 127 damage is still pretty darn good.

I was trying to figure out if he could also trigger his universal donor to take damage and deal more damage instead of healing, but I couldn't make it work, since he needs to prevent death twice to trigger both from the brink's and then still have enough hp to deal himself non-fatal damage to make that work, but any improvements would be appreciated.

Okay, let’s see how much the Magnifica Gambit is worth at dealing damage to a single target! This is my first one of these, so somebody please check my math.

Assume that La Comodora has two cards in her deck, a copy of Run Aground and both Flintlock and Cutlasses in her trash, and two Harnessed Anomalies as well as the second Run Aground in hand. She also has a copy of Maria Helena’s Plot, Chronological Sweetspot, and Combat Timing, along with ONE Concordant Helm and all her other equipment (15 cards) with the Figureheads last in line. The other Helms are in the trash.

Start of turn: she lets all the portals on her ship close and fuels Chronological Sweetspot. All Equipments except for the Concordant Helm are destroyed. For each of the first 12 equipment destroyed, she deals 1 + 2x Figurehead boost damage to one target. The first Figurehead then causes 2 damage, and the last causes 1. Total: 12*3 + 2 + 1 = 39.

Draw: La Comodora draws the two cards in her deck.

Play: she plays Harnessed Anomaly, shuffling Run Aground into her empty deck and playing it. She shuffles 15 equipment cards into her deck, and deals one target 15 damage. (Leave two Concordant Helms, to prevent the limited keyword from interfering with the next step.) Total: 39 + 15 = 54.

For the card play on Harnessed Anomaly, she plays Weigh Anchor, putting all her equipments back in play and emptying her deck again.

Power: using her base power, La Comodora puts that copy of Harnessed Anomaly she played earlier from her trash under the top card of her empty deck, making it the only card in her deck.

End of turn: first, the Chronological Sweetspot goes off. La Comodora reveals her Harnessed Anomaly, choosing Flintlock and Cutlass from her trash. She deals one target 2 + 2 and 2 + 2 damage. For the extra card play, she plays the second copy of Harnessed Anomaly from her hand, choosing another Flintlock and Cutlass from her trash. She deals one target 2 + 2 and 2 + 2 damage. For the second Anomaly’s extra play, she plays Run Aground out of her hand, shuffling the last 2 Concordant Helms into her deck and dealing one target 2 + 2 damage. Total: 54 + 20 = 74.

Then La Comodora’s equipment effects trigger. The two Cannon Portals do 2*(3 + 2) damage to one target and the two Brig Teleporters do 2*(1 + 2) damage. (Subtotal: 16.) The two Temporal Rigging cards let her use the powers on the two Future-Tech Deck Guns, dealing one target 2*(1 + 2) damage. For one of the Deck Guns, she targets herself and would do 3 damage, but Combat Timing prevents it and La Comodora deals one target 2 + 2 damage instead. (She can also throw some damage at other targets here, if she wants. Subtotal: 10.) Total: 74 + 26 = 100!

For some extra support to other heroes at this point, she can now have Timeless Treasure award extra card draws or move the Paradoja Figureheads around. And the best part is, this being the expert time traveler La Comodora, she should be able to repeat the majority of this on her very next turn.

So, Luminary. Now, if the villain deals damage to all hero targets while Luminary has all his devices in play, plus "All According to Plan" in play (It gives devices +1 to damage) his backlash generators can do 18 * 6 = 108... +6 (from a disposable defender taking extra damage for Luminary himself) so 114 total damage to the villain, which is more than he can do on his own turn.

On his turn, he needs an All According to Plan, all his devices in play (18), a Hasten Victory in hand, and 3 cards in his deck, which are in order: 2x Hasten Victory and Dangerous Vision. And the other 17 cards in his trash. 

For his play phase, play the Hasten Victory for 1 damage, which loops into 2 more (3) and then his dangerous vision, which destroys all his devices except for the orbital death laser, putting 38 cards in his trash, and dealing 1 damage per device destroyed, 17 damage (20) For his power phase, uses his orbital death laser for 38 (+1 cuz the laser is a device) damage and another 1 damage from All according to plan when it destroys itself, 40 damage, (60)

Heroic Luminary can get a little more I think.... She'd want the same setup, except with a Bared Blade in her deck under the 2 Hasten Victory's to give her an extra power. She'd play the Hasten Victory chain for 3 damage, and then her first power would be the orbital death laser for 23 damage (26) her second power would be her base power for 18 (44), and at the end of her turn 3 Sabre Battle Drones would destroy 3 other devices, like repair nanites for 21 damage (2 per drone automatically, 4 per drone because it destroyed another device, and then +3 more from Luminary as all according to plan triggers) for a total of 65 on her turn.

 

Now that makes me think.... if regular Luminary keeps 4 devices in play after his Dangerous Vision play: 3 sabre battle drones and 1 other, and only destroys 13 devices, that's 3 from the Hasten Victories,+ 13 from the destruction (16) and his laser will deal 36 damage (52) and then at the end of his turn, the first sabre drone deals 2 damage and destroys a non sabre drone for 4 (58), the second sabre drone deals 2 damage and then destroys the first sabre drone for 4 (64) and the third sabre drone deals 2 and destroys the second for 4 (70) +3 for 3 devices being destroyed, (73)

Huh, so I guess you get more total damage from destroying most of  their stuff with a Dangerous Vision than you do by using Heroic Luminary's base power with all devices out. how about that?
